summary: LYSE ENERGI AS (org. no. 980 335 224) is a private limited company (AS) based in Stavanger, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 35.150 (Handel med elektrisitet); it has 10 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.47 bn and net income was -NOK 12.8 m. CEO: Ane Christophersen; board chair: Leiv Ingve Ørke; auditor: DELOITTE AS. Also: LEI 5967007LIEEXZXI8G879, ultimate parent LYSE AS.
